about: Every key of the 19 vendor .GUJ keyboards, layer 0 (printed, normal+shift by ASCII char) and layer 1 (Ctrl+Space), as answered by S8GujU64 (composerU, raw with carriers) and S8Guj764 (composer7, raw Shree-Lipi 7 bytes), plus the code the 406-byte file holds for the key. Captured 2026-10-18 from byte copies C:/Users/harde/AppData/Local/Temp/r3g/VA?.GUJ, twice, stable.
